ValidationRule.description: CCC: Restricts the user other than System Admin from editing the fields of Placeholder record type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" && $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Administrator" && $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - Freight" && $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - QCC" && $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - SND" && RecordType.Name = "Placeholder" && (ISCHANGED(FirstName) || ISCHANGED(LastName) || ISCHANGED(Salutation) || ISCHANGED(AccountId) || ISCHANGED(Description))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Null Contacts are not to be edited.
